name: Sue Himmelrich
office: City of Santa Monica, Member of the Rent Control Board

items.text: Sue Himmelrich is a tenants' rights attorney and former Santa Monica City Council member. She served on the council from 2014 to 2022, including two years as mayor. She works at Western Center on Law & Poverty.

sentences.text: Sue Himmelrich is a tenants' rights attorney and former Santa Monica City Council member.
She served on the council from 2014 to 2022, including two years as mayor.
She works at Western Center on Law & Poverty.

items.text: Her campaign says she wants to defend rent-controlled housing against luxury redevelopment and prevent displacement, except where there is a genuine safety necessity. She says she supported lowering the annual rent increase cap to 3% for rent-controlled tenants. On the council, she advocated for banning discrimination against Section 8 renters. She advocated for stronger eviction protections for students and teachers. She backed two ballot measures that she says generated at least $60 million for renter assistance and affordable housing.
